generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster with a limited red-toned palette on a cream background depicts a dreamlike scene under a stormy, misty night with lightning. The bold headline "act pas slm ff" arches across the top in a mid-century serif font, adorned with mid-century sparkle and starburst icons. A stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous, almost weightless pink donut with viscous chocolate dripping from it and a small pinkish-red flower rests upon it, appearing centrally. Tiny, brightly colored, translucent sprinkles are scattered across its holographic icing, and its base is a soft golden hue. Next to it, an eggplant holds a syringe, and a viscous, bright white liquid is present. The overall impression is one of ethereal beauty with a sarcastic undertone, typical of a 1950s beauty ad and a vintage snark poster.
